taxonomy.label: Foundation Subsidence
taxonomy.description: Settlement or subsidence affecting the foundation or supporting fill.

taxonomy.label: Sand-Fill Settlement
taxonomy.description: Settlement of sand-fill associated with the temple's supporting structure.

taxonomy.label: Stone Displacement
taxonomy.description: Movement or displacement of loose stone elements.

taxonomy.label: Stone Loosening
taxonomy.description: Loosening of stone parts requiring monitoring or further examination.

taxonomy.label: Stone Cracking
taxonomy.description: Cracking observed in stone wall or masonry elements.

taxonomy.label: Stone Fragment Loss
taxonomy.description: Loss or falling of fragments from stone elements.

taxonomy.label: Stone Fall
taxonomy.description: Falling of a stone element from a structural location.

taxonomy.label: Water Penetration
taxonomy.description: Penetration of water into monument fabric identified as a long-term conservation concern.

taxonomy.label: Water Logging
taxonomy.description: Accumulation or retention of water requiring drainage or pumping measures.

taxonomy.label: Soil Erosion
taxonomy.description: Erosion of surrounding or supporting soil associated with rain and environmental exposure.

taxonomy.label: Mechanical Wind Erosion
taxonomy.description: Mechanical erosion caused by wind action and airborne particles.

taxonomy.label: Sand Blasting
taxonomy.description: Surface erosion associated with wind-borne sand particles.

taxonomy.label: Saline Action
taxonomy.description: Deterioration pressure associated with saline coastal conditions.

taxonomy.label: Metal Cramp Corrosion
taxonomy.description: Corrosion of metal cramps associated with salt-air exposure and documented cracking.

taxonomy.label: Microbiological Growth
taxonomy.description: Microbiological growth identified as a deterioration pressure.

taxonomy.label: Vegetative Intrusion
taxonomy.description: Unwanted vegetative growth requiring periodic control.

taxonomy.label: Cyclone Damage
taxonomy.description: Damage caused by cyclone activity; specifically documented for the site's green belt in the 2000 monitoring record.

severityPolicy.rule: A severity value must not be populated unless supported by a documented scoring methodology or source evidence.
